panel.title: Kraftvakt
panel.not_loaded: Kraftvakt is not loaded. Check the integration under Settings → Devices & services.

status.stopped_info: The regulation is stopped, and all regulated appliances and EV chargers are turned off. The configuration can be changed. When the regulation starts, the appliances are turned on again one by one.
status.start_refused: The regulation cannot start before the configuration is complete.
status.safe_state_text: The power sensor {sensor} gives no valid measurement. All regulated appliances and EV chargers are turned off. The regulation starts again by itself when the sensor gives a valid value again.
status.penalty_text: The average consumption has been above the power limit. All regulated appliances and EV chargers are kept off until the overconsumption is recovered.
status.waiting_to_increase: Waiting, the current is increased in about {time}
status.waiting_charger: Waiting: another EV charger is charging

missing.missing_power_sensor: The power sensor is not chosen.
missing.missing_charge_power_sensor: {item}: the sensor for charging power is missing.
missing.missing_car_connected: {item}: «car connected» is missing. It is required when only one EV charger may charge at a time.
missing.charger_without_entity: An EV charger without an entity

config.fix_before_saving: Fix the marked settings before saving.
config.not_saved: The configuration was not saved. Fix the marked settings.
config.save_refused_running: The configuration cannot be saved while the regulation runs.
config.leave_text: The changes on the configuration pages are not saved. They are lost if you leave.

locked.title: The configuration is locked
locked.text: The regulation runs. Stop the regulation to change the configuration. When the regulation stops, all regulated appliances and EV chargers are turned off.

warning.appliances_title: Do not turn regulated appliances on or off outside Kraftvakt
warning.chargers_title: Do not turn EV chargers on or off outside Kraftvakt
warning.text: Manual control and automations can disturb the regulation, affect appliances with higher priority and trigger a penalty.

errors.car_connected_required: Required when only one EV charger may charge at a time.
errors.duplicate_label: The label must be unique for the appliance.
errors.min_current_above_max: The minimum current cannot be above the maximum current.
errors.window_start_equals_end: Start and end cannot be the same.
errors.duplicate_entity: The entity is already used by another appliance or EV charger.
errors.invalid_action: Home Assistant cannot read the action.
errors.invalid_template: The template has a syntax error.
errors.default_action_unavailable: The entity has no standard action. Choose a custom action.

general.capacity_window_info: The capacity window is fixed at one hour and cannot be changed.

power_sensor.label: Power sensor
power_sensor.helper: The sensor that measures the total power of the house, in W or kW.

regulation_window_s.label: Regulation window
regulation_window_s.helper: The period the regulation average is calculated over. {min}–{max} s, default {default} s.

power_limit_kw.label: Power limit
power_limit_kw.helper: The highest allowed average consumption per hour. {min}–{max} kW, default {default} kW.

wait_at_limit_min.label: Waiting time at the power limit
wait_at_limit_min.helper: How long an appliance waits before it is turned on when the regulation average is at the power limit. Shorter when the average is lower. {min}–{max} min, default {default} min.

penalty_threshold_kw.label: Penalty threshold
penalty_threshold_kw.helper: How much the average consumption may exceed the power limit before a penalty starts. {min}–{max} kW, default {default} kW.

appliances.priority_sub: Top = highest priority, turned off last
appliances.empty: No appliances yet. Add the appliances Kraftvakt may turn off when the consumption is too high.

appliance.variants_info: A variant gives the appliance another place in the priority list while its expression is true. The top true expression applies. A new variant is put at the bottom of the priority list.

entity_id.label: Entity
entity_id.helper: The name in Home Assistant becomes the name of the appliance. The entity is available as entity_id and entity (the state object) in templates and actions.

power_reserve_kw.label: Power reserve (optional)
power_reserve_kw.helper: Free power that must be available before the appliance is turned on. Use it for appliances that draw a lot as soon as they are turned on.

action.no_default: The entity type has no standard action, so the action must be custom.
action.choose_entity: Choose the entity to use the standard action.

condition.entity_helper: True only when the entity is on. Unavailable counts as false.
condition.template_helper: True only when the template gives the boolean value true. Variables: entity_id, entity.

charging.enabled_sub: When it is off, the EV chargers are left to themselves and «EV charging» is removed from the priority list.
charging.one_at_a_time: One EV charger at a time
charging.one_at_a_time_sub: An EV charger that charges may continue until the car is full or disconnected. The others wait.
charging.disabled_info: EV charging control is off. The EV chargers below are kept, but Kraftvakt sends no commands to them.
charging.chargers_sub: Charging priority, highest at the top
charging.switches_info: For each EV charger Kraftvakt makes two switches that can also be used while the regulation runs: «‹charger› excluded from regulation» and «‹charger› override charging window».

charger.minimum_first: The charging current is always set to the minimum before the EV charger is activated or deactivated.

entity_id.label: Entity for allowed charging
entity_id.helper: Normally the charger's switch for allowing charging. The name in Home Assistant becomes the name of the EV charger. The entity is available as entity_id and entity in templates and actions.

max_current_a.label: Maximum charging current
max_current_a.helper: Whole amperes. The minimum cannot be above the maximum.

charge_power_sensor.label: Sensor for charging power
charge_power_sensor.helper: Above 100 W counts as charging. Unavailable counts as charging.

power_reserve_kw.label: Power reserve
power_reserve_kw.helper: The power the EV charger draws when charging starts at the minimum current. {min}–{max} kW, default {default} kW (about 6 A on three phases, 400 V).

car_connected.helper: The car counts as connected only when the value is true. Unavailable counts as not connected.

charging_window.label: Charging window (optional)
charging_window.helper: Can span midnight. Start and end cannot be the same. Without a charging window, the EV charger is always allowed to charge.
